messages:
Jamie H: Quick heads-up — external security review from AcmeSec is booked for Mon/Tue next week. They want to run vuln scans, limited exploitation on staging, and config checks. We need windows for RBAC ephemeral creds, KMS access questions, and an audit-log export plan. Who can own scheduling + remediation tracking?
Alex P: Do we know which environments exactly? staging only or staging + read-only access to prod logging? Also need legal sign-off on scope.
Jamie H: Primary target is staging. They'll request read-only access to prod logs (CloudTrail/our audit stream) if needed — we can gate that. Legal already OK with scoped read-only; ops just needs the exact ACLs.
Maria L: I can own remediation tracker and runbook. For access: propose ephemeral role (72h max) with scoped kms:Decrypt for testing key-wrap only, no plaintext export. Need 48h lead time to create ephemeral role and session policy.
Kevin S: Infra can stand up the role. FYI we need 48h to provision and test the role in staging and 72h to smoke prod-read flows. We can do an S3 presigned-bucket for log uploads. Also please freeze infra changes in the window.
Olivia R: Audit/observability asks: retention snapshot for the last 90 days must be ready and a log-export job that produces a cohesive tarball + index. Recommend presigned S3 + signed manifest for verifiability.
Maria L: Suggested session policy snippet for the ephemeral role (example):
```
{
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111111:key/abcd-1234",
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalTag/session_type": "external_review"}}
}
```
Kevin S: That policy works. We'll attach a condition to require mfa and tag-based expiry. Also don't forget to disable long-lived console keys for reviewers.
Product-Security: For remediation tracking, let's use the weekly tracker in the shared drive + a PR-style pipeline: issue created -> owner assigned -> SLA 7 days for triage. I'll create templates.
Maria L: Runbook / escalation in case they trigger something worth escalating (short version):
1) Reviewer flags exploit -> oncall notified (pager)
2) Isolate service / toggle read-only if needed
3) Rotate affected keys (via KMS proxy)
4) Collect forensics: export logs (S3 presigned), freeze snapshots
5) Postmortem + timeline + patch rollout
Please make sure ops and legal are cc'd.
Kevin S: Clarify KMS ops needed: decrypt-only for wrapped payload validation, no grants for raw key material. Confirmed. We'll provide a KMS proxy endpoint and audit logs for any KMS calls.
Olivia R: Also please confirm the audit log retention requirement for the engagement — AcmeSec may request up to 30 days of live logs and a 90-day snapshot. We can do that but need the time to snapshot and verify integrity (sha256 manifest).
Jamie H: Cool. Can someone create the calendar invite + add the tracker link? I'll run a dry-run Thursday. Also want a 1hr pre-window sync with oncall and infra.
Infra Bot: calendar invite created: External Review — Pre-window sync Thu 10:00 — attendees: Jamie H, Maria L, Kevin S, Olivia R, Product-Security.
Alex P: Dry-run ack. I'll block the 1hr slot and will prep a short checklist for RBAC role testing.
Maria L: I'll start the remediation sheet and add the runbook + escalation contacts. Sharing link once done.
Jamie H: Perfect — :thumbsup: Let's aim to have roles provisioned and the log snapshot validated 48 hours before the engagement.
